verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page lists 'Unlimited Visual Automations' and its webhooks docs show event-driven reactions (webhooks fire the moment activity happens, with signed delivery and retry logic), indicating some automatic rule/trigger-action capability exists. However, there is no detailed documentation of how rules/conditions are defined within the automation builder, nor any AI-native mechanism for an agent to author or manage these automation rules itself. Missing for 10: documentation of the rule/trigger-action builder's conditions and logic, and evidence that AI agents (via MCP or API) can create/modify automation rules rather than just call broadcast/webhook endpoints.
